notes.title: Update
notes.content:
The patch 1.2 introduced improvements and the full controller support in the game.

Improvements:
- Full controller support.
- Full keyboard control in the game menu.
- Device craft new animation.
- Repeating tutorials are less common.
- Device craft new audio.

Game Design:
-Difficulty Adjustment, you will see less chickens during the first runs of the stages, they will appear with certain triggers in the game.

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
The patch 1.1 fixed some bugs and also introduced some improvements in the game.

Bug Fix:
-Load problems.
-Rendering problems.
-Adjustments Galinacio meters.
-Adjustments for the interface to behave in a functional way on larger screen sizes.

Improvements:
-Galinacio approximation warning.
-Music by Galinacio below 5m.
-Keyboard sprite.
-Trampoline audio.

Game Design:
-The "Exit" feature has been removed from the aquatic environment.
-Cage piece in Stage 2 is in different spot.

notes.title: Launch Announcement!
notes.content:
We are so glad for the launch of our first project, Wisly and the Chickens! Is the first game developed by Dynix Studios.

The work was extremely hard and complex, so, arriving at this moment is extremely rewarding.

We know that the game is still not in its best possible stage, having said that, we would also like to announce that we are already working on improvements and also on polishing the game.

Lastly, we want to thank everyone who has supported this project so far and also our future players!

Feel free to report any problems and also to send us any suggestions!
contact@dynixstudios.com

Lets run!
